target.merge_policy: Preserve already grouped source labels; do not reconstruct unobserved original categories.
target.null_policy: Retain case in complete artifact and coverage; exclude from both graded denominators without imputation.

transport.input_identity: Actual canonical observation SHA256 and opaque case ID, identical across workflows.
transport.driver_error_to_abstention_mapping: Separate prospective execution policy required; preserve original output and operational reason.

primary.name: mean_operational_normalized_ordinal_RPS_loss
primary.abstention_margin_reason: Exceeds the conservative raw-RPS bound (1 + 0.000001)^2 permitted by the unchanged probability-sum tolerance.
primary.denominator: All authenticated non-null source targets, including abstentions and short/empty observations.
primary.properness_scope: The probabilistic RPS component is strictly proper on the exact probability simplex; the operational aggregate separately adds abstention penalties and numeric tolerance.

secondary.point_prediction: Smallest category whose supplied cumulative probability is at least 0.5.
secondary.exact_category_accuracy: Labeled abstentions count as incorrect; use the same complete labeled denominator.
secondary.per_category_recall: All labeled cases in each source category; abstentions are misses; unsupported categories are undefined.
secondary.answered_only_RPS: Diagnostic only, with explicit answered denominator; never replaces primary loss.

paired_comparison.formula: mean(L_viewer_only - L_code_enabled) over the same non-null source targets
paired_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive paired difference on this fixed observed cohort, not a population treatment effect.

recording_summaries.secondary_equal_record_mean: Mean across the same recordings with nonzero labeled support, with explicit support count.

evaluation_assistance.additional_assistance: Separate named and disclosed workflow condition.

source_component_obligations.authenticate_complete_actual_case_observ: Trusted evaluator driver, before scoring execution.
source_component_obligations.qualify_participant_runtime_isolation: Separate execution prerequisite; host Python objects are not a sandbox.
source_component_obligations.freeze_model_backend_prompts_tools_and_b: Future execution prerequisite, not a source implementation gate.
